newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firmer but weaker futures trim gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firmer but weaker futures trim gains.

text.p: NWE spot gasoline was firmer but eased from early highs as futures markets on both sides of the Atlantic retraced Friday's late gains, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded around $4 firmer at $209 and $210 a tonne fob ARA, with tighter Rotterdam refiner supply continuing to hold a $1 premium to other installations in the ARA region.

Traders said the market remained fairly well supported against the weaker futures markets, with supplies of higher octane grades tightening as poor reforming margins saw refiners reducing platformer throughput.
